llm.summary: This Vercel skill is a disclosed Maton-based integration whose sensitive actions are mostly gated by user approval, with a supply-chain caution around installing Maton packages.

dimensions.detail: Network access, Maton authentication, and credential-store use are proportionate for an API integration and are disclosed; raw API-key HTTP use is documented only as a fallback with handling cautions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses pinned npm, Homebrew, pip, and SDK package versions, but the artifact does not provide checksum or signature verification for those external packages.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill defaults to read/list operations, requires explicit approval for new connections and writes, treats external data as untrusted, and limits undocumented endpoints to user-named requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens, Vercel connections, hosted functions, triggers, destinations, and watch checkpoints can persist, but the skill discloses these effects and generally requires user approval for creating, invoking, forwarding, or deleting them.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented purpose is Vercel API access through Maton OAuth, covering projects, deployments, domains, teams, and environment variables; these capabilities fit the stated integration purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, verify you trust Maton and prefer OAuth over API keys. Review any write, function, trigger, or destination request carefully, especially changes to production projects, domains, team access, or environment variables.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The unverified third-party CLI/SDK installation concern is real as a supply-chain caution, but package installation is disclosed, version-pinned, and coherent with using Maton; no artifact evidence shows malicious or hidden payload execution.
